note: A waiver is a CEILING, never a mute, and --prove-waiver fails the lane if it changes no outcome. This lane's whole behaviour sits behind multi_flow_hands, which is false at the tip of this branch, so the census must stand STILL. The single ceiling below exists only for the case where making a flow set available to the layout changes a tie-break in block packing and moves a candidate. If this lane needs a larger waiver, the switch has leaked into the default and that is the defect. Integration runs --no-waivers on the merged tree.

waivers.cause: a flow set on a hand record can change a deterministic tie-break in block packing, which can move which candidate is judged first; the arrangement rule is unchanged while the switch is off
